info.title: Preregister
info.description:
ENGLISH:
The API has methods to preregister one or more shipments, modify the data of a shipment, cancel a shipment and get the information of your shipments.
ESPAÑOL:
La API cuenta con métodos para preregistrar uno o más envíos, modificar los datos de un envío, cancelar un envío y obtener la información de tus envíos.

post.description: Shipments preregister. As input, it has general information about the shipments, sender, recipient, packages, added values ​​and customs information. If the input data is correct, it returns the codes of the preregistered shipments. For the service to respond, you must obtain the JWT token from CorreosID. Link https://identidad.correos.es/ You can obtain moreinformation about security from Correos API's on the home page https://anypoint.mulesoft.com/exchange/ c6c3f076-c4b3-41bc-bef8-7f60e7c93885/preregister/minor/1.3/

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Used to send a valid OAuth 2 access token

post.description: Shipments Cn preregister. As input, it has general information about the shipments, sender, recipient, packages, added values ​​and customs information. If the input data is correct, it returns the codes of the preregistered shipments If its mixed returns the codes of the preregistered and shows the results of the wrong ones. Only available for POAXAC products. For the service to respond, you must obtain the JWT token from CorreosID. Link https://identidad.correos.es/ You can obtain moreinformation about security from Correos API's on the home page https://anypoint.mulesoft.com/exchange/c6c3f076-c4b3-41bc-bef8-7f60e7c93885/preregister/minor/1.3/
